content.text: I will run the minimal sequence of read-only collection, parsing, comparison, safety check, cleanup, and summary creation in a single script and output the CPU count for extraction. I'll run that now.

arguments:
{"script":"#!/bin/bash
set -e
DIR="cpu_check_workspace"
mkdir -p "$DIR"

# Collect raw artifacts
cat /proc/cpuinfo > "$DIR/cpuinfo.raw"
if command -v lscpu >/dev/null 2>&1; then lscpu > "$DIR/lscpu.raw"; else echo "lscpu_not_available" > "$DIR/lscpu.raw"; fi
grep '^cpu' /proc/stat > "$DIR/cpu_stat.raw"
nproc > "$DIR/nproc.raw"
uptime > "$DIR/uptime.raw"

# Parse cpuinfo
processors=$(grep -c '^processor' "$DIR/cpuinfo.raw" || true)
model=$(grep -m1 'model name' "$DIR/cpuinfo.raw" | cut -d: -f2- | sed 's/^ //' || true)
cores_per_cpu=$(grep -m1 '^cpu cores' "$DIR/cpuinfo.raw" | cut -d: -f2- | sed 's/^ //' || true)
siblings=$(grep -m1 '^siblings' "$DIR/cpuinfo.raw" | cut -d: -f2- | sed 's/^ //' || true)

echo "processors: $processors" > "$DIR/cpuinfo.parsed"
echo "model: ${model:-unknown}" >> "$DIR/cpuinfo.parsed"
echo "cpu cores: ${cores_per_cpu:-unknown}" >> "$DIR/cpuinfo.parsed"
echo "siblings: ${siblings:-unknown}" >> "$DIR/cpuinfo.parsed"

# Parse lscpu
if grep -q 'lscpu_not_available' "$DIR/lscpu.raw"; then
  echo "lscpu: not available" > "$DIR/lscpu.parsed"
else
  awk -F: '{gsub(/^ +| +$/,"",$1); gsub(/^ +| +$/,"",$2); print $1": "$2}' "$DIR/lscpu.raw" > "$DIR/lscpu.parsed"
fi

# Parse /proc/stat: compute total and idle percentage
awk '{ if($1~"cpu"){sum=0; for(i=2;i<=NF;i++) sum+=$i; idle=$5; if(sum>0) printf "%s total=%d idle=%d idle_pct=%.2f\n",$1,sum,idle, (idle/sum*100); else printf "%s total=%d idle=%d idle_pct=%.2f\n",$1,sum,idle,0 }}' "$DIR/cpu_stat.raw" > "$DIR/cpu_stat.parsed"

# nproc parsed
nproc_val=$(cat "$DIR/nproc.raw")
echo "nproc: $nproc_val" > "$DIR/nproc.parsed"

# Compare parsed artifacts
: > "$DIR/discrepancies.log"
cpus_from_nproc=$nproc_val
cpus_from_cpuinfo=$processors
cpus_from_lscpu=$(grep -i '^cpu(s):' "$DIR/lscpu.raw" 2>/dev/null | head -n1 | sed 's/.*://' | xargs || true)
[ -z "$cpus_from_lscpu" ] && cpus_from_lscpu="unknown"
if [ "$cpus_from_nproc" != "$cpus_from_cpuinfo" ]; then
  echo "CPU count mismatch: nproc=$cpus_from_nproc vs /proc/cpuinfo=$cpus_from_cpuinfo" >> "$DIR/discrepancies.log"
fi
if [ "$cpus_from_lscpu" != "unknown" ] && [ "$cpus_from_lscpu" != "$cpus_from_cpuinfo" ]; then
  echo "CPU count mismatch: lscpu=$cpus_from_lscpu vs /proc/cpuinfo=$cpus_from_cpuinfo" >> "$DIR/discrepancies.log"
fi
model_lscpu=$(grep -i '^Model name:' "$DIR/lscpu.raw" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/Model name:[ \t]*//' | head -n1 || true)
if [ -n "$model_lscpu" ] && [ "$model_lscpu" != "$model" ]; then
  echo "Model name mismatch: lscpu='${model_lscpu}' vs /proc/cpuinfo='${model}'" >> "$DIR/discrepancies.log"
fi

# Safety check: detect regular files modified in last 1 minute outside workspace and virtual FS
external=$(find / -xdev -type f -mmin -1 -not -path "$PWD/$DIR/*" -not -path "/proc/*" -not -path "/sys/*" -not -path "/dev/*" -not -path "/run/*" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || true)
if [ -z "$external" ]; then
  echo "safety_check: no external file modifications detected in last 1 minute" > "$DIR/safety_check.log"
else
  echo "safety_check: external modifications detected: $external" > "$DIR/safety_check.log"
fi

# Remove transient intermediate files (none expected, but clean *.tmp)
rm -f "$DIR"/*.tmp 2>/dev/null || true

# Consolidate summary
{
  echo "CPU summary generated from workspace: $PWD/$DIR"
  echo
  echo "CPU count (nproc): $cpus_from_nproc"
  echo "CPU count (/proc/cpuinfo): $cpus_from_cpuinfo"
  echo "CPU count (lscpu): $cpus_from_lscpu"
  echo "Model (/proc/cpuinfo): ${model:-unknown}"
  [ -n "$model_lscpu" ] && echo "Model (lscpu): $model_lscpu"
  echo
  echo "Idle percentages (from /proc/stat snapshot):"
  cat "$DIR/cpu_stat.parsed"
  echo
  if [ -s "$DIR/discrepancies.log" ]; then
    echo "Discrepancies:"
    cat "$DIR/discrepancies.log"
  else
    echo "No discrepancies detected"
  fi
  echo
  echo "Safety check:"
  cat "$DIR/safety_check.log"
  echo
  echo "READY_FOR_INSPECTION: yes"
} > "$DIR/cpu_summary.txt"

# Output the CPU count for extraction
echo "CPU_COUNT: $cpus_from_nproc"
"}
